[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The formula itself delivers solid hydration, but the overall experience leaves me conflicted. The jar packaging is a drawback for me—dipping my fingers in each time feels unhygienic and makes me worry about the product losing freshness over time. The texture is very rich, which initially seemed promising for my dry skin, but I noticed it tends to clog my pores and occasionally lead to breakouts. Because of that, I only use it in my nighttime routine, when my skin can better tolerate heavier products. On the positive side, it does hydrate well. My skin looks more plump, healthy, and refreshed when I wake up, which I appreciate. However, considering the price point, I find it hard to justify repurchasing. I've achieved similar results with more affordable drugstore options, making this feel a bit overpriced for what it delivers.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to give this 5 stars because the formula itself is BEAUTIFUL. The texture is thick, cushiony, and feels so luxe going on. It spreads easily, absorbs well for a richer night cream, and leaves skin feeling super soft and nourished by morning. It truly feels like a high end, comforting barrier repair cream. Unfortunately my skin just does not love shea butter. After a few nights of use I started getting small closed comedones, especially on my chin area where I'm most congestion prone. That is a personal skin issue though, not a problem with the product itself. If you are not sensitive to shea butter or don't break out easily from richer creams, I honestly think you would LOVE this. It is deeply moisturizing and feels amazing on the skin. I will be passing this along to my mom because I know her drier skin is going to drink this up.

I like this nigh time cream, it's nice and thick and I feel like it really cakes on for extra moisture. When you wake up in the morning, it's all soaked in and your face feels so hydrated

I use this at night after applying Skin Medica .5 Retinol serum and I always wake up the following morning with my skin looking bright, clear, and moisturized. I originally was using the FAB .25 Retinol and the Ultra Repair Cream but wanted to use more intense/targeted products while still saying hydrated.
I have used this for many years love the hydration for my face!!

This cream is worth every penny!! I've been using this night cream for the past week and I can see a visible change on my fine lines on my my forehead. My skin feels softer to the touch and looks firmer

I love FAB creams so was excited to try this night cream. I've been experimenting with more actives and wanted a nice, simple but powerful hydrating night cream I could use after those: this did the trick and did not irritate my skin!
Very happy with it for my dry skin! Would definitely recommend!

I'm loving this night cream! I wake up in the morning less puffy and not a single dry patch in sight. I only gave it 4 stars, because I haven't been using it that long and want to see long term effects before!
Why did you guys discontinue the sleeping cream version? I have been using it for 5 years and now I can't find anything as good as that. Please please make those cream available again!

This is the first FAB product I have tried and I will definitely buy again! My skin is combination and acne prone. This moisturizer doesn't feel too heavy and actually improves my skin overnight. Highly recommend!

In the fall/winter of 2020, my skin became dehydrated from tennis and also the cold. My mom got me the OG Fab beauty repair cream and me and my skin loved it. I switched to this cream after needing a 'thicker' night cream. I love this so much, I use it nightly around the size of a dime. When I feel my skin in the morning, my cheeks are so soft and my redness is down. love love love. (I'm almost 19 and have been using over a year. I have dry to normal sensitive skin. I'm not too acne prone but this never broke me out or burned.)

I ordered this because I find the daytime normal moisturizer from FAB to be too light for me at night. honestly, this one barely moisturizes me any more and it's a lot more pricey. I have dry skin and I feel just barely hydrated about 1-2 minutes after putting this on, and then ten minutes later my skin feels dry as heck again. not for me.
This is so moisturizing for me since I have sensitive skin with rosacea and acne prone. I use it morning and night after washing my face. It's great and have used it for years

Before I started using this night cream, I had used one that destroyed my skin. After just one night, I saw a difference and overall I felt like it was a positive experience! I like that it's not too heavy but it's pretty moisturizing. I do notice that by itself, it's not doing a lot to my skin that other night creams can do alone. I can tell that it is more effective if you layer it with other serums or chemical exfoliants. I also don't think it soaks completely into the skin very well, which I think other serums can help with. Overall, I like it but don't love it.

Usually most products work on my skin. I'm not one of those sensitive people at all. However after using this for 10 nights as a night cream, this one weirdly caused me to have patches of dry skin around my cheeks and jaw line. I liked how thick the cream is but it didn't work for me. This is the first time I'll be returning a skin care product. Guess I'll be going back to my Kielhs night cream instead.
I have very acne prone combination skin so I thought I would try this since it's non-comedogenic. I've been using it for around 2 weeks now and it broken me out so bad.

My skin has been super dry and flakey this winter, no serums or other moisturizers seemed to help. I tried this and my skin drank it in, it felt immediately quenched, and the next day felt supple and glowy. Fragrance free too- win!

I am the most sensitive skinned and this is the ONLY line I don't react to!!! I've tried a handful of styles and every single one works wonders and doesn't cause a rash. I could cry I'm so happy to find products I can use! The night cream was so soft and luxurious. Skin felt super smooth. It's a really cool texture too. Get it!
I never write reviews but I had to for this cream. I love using it over my serum.

avis.titre: Best night cream for dry skin!
avis.texte: The cream is an absolute staple in my night routine. I use the original moisturizer in the AM under my spf and this in the PM after showering and it really works.

This product really helped me a lot in the process of recovering my dry skin due to changing environment. At the same time very comfortable for my sensitive skin. I like thick cream, but it's very easy to absorb into the skin.
I have super sensitive dry skin and o suffer from eczema. This transformed my skin and made it glass! No more pumps or dry patches.

An aesthetician recommended this brand and product for me when I was developing a skin care routine. The price is out of my league however I did splurge. It truly is a hydrating firming cream. I used it during the winter months and did notice some dryness on the sides of my nose like I do every year. Overall it felt very moisturizing and didn't leave my skin looking oily. A little goes a long way and the results were satisfying. Four stars only because of the price.

This sits on my nightstand right now. It doesn't burn my face at all, and a little goes a long way. It layers beautifully on top of all my other serums. The price point is very reasonable for how long it lasts.
I have really picky/sensitive combination skin. I use this at night after using the cleanser before bed and it makes my face so soft!

My skin has become sensitive as I've aged and have tried several different moisturizers. Finally I tried First Aid and this moisturizer after searching for products recommended for sensitive skin. This is it for me! I've been using for months and on my 2nd jar. It calms and firms my skin. No more dry patches or puffiness. Best of all it's not greasy and doesn't clog my pores! Thank you for making such a great product.

Hands down I love this product. I actually love all of the products by this brand. I have really dry skin and it's always been a big problem. This product really helped add moisture and hydration into my skin. I'd definitely get it again and again
I'm very particular about products. This was perfect for me at nighttime. It offers great hydration without any perfume.

avis.titre: Great night time moisturizer, even for combo skin
avis.texte: I have combination, acne-prone skin and I live in a humid city. It is definitely a nighttime product- unless you have the driest skin this will be too heavy for day use. I have been using it for a week now and haven't noticed any new breakouts, and my skin is so soft when I wake up. It is super hydrating but doesn't feel occlusive. A little goes a looong way so the price is justifiable to me, though it is more than I imagined spending on a moisturizer. I also love that it doesn't have a scent to it.
Feels soothing and effective and all things comfortable and fabulous

I truly love this cream, I don't often write reviews but I am helping a friend build her routine and I suggested this to her so decided I should also write a review while I am at it. I leaves my skin moisturized but not greasy, I have combo to normal skin depending on the season. My skin feels glorious every morning after using this.

It clogged my pores and made me feel greasy in the a.m. used it for a few weeks thinking it was something out and I lost the clear skin I worked so hard for trying something new. I have skin more on the oily side. I wanted to like it but it isn't for me.

I bought this product to use during the winter and ensure my skin stay hydrated throughout the night. It's an amazing night cream. Non greasy, super absorbent, love that is has no fragrance. I woke up and my face didn't feel like all it's moisture had been drained.

This is probably my 4th or 5th jar of this. I did find it a little weird that this jar wasn't in its normal packaging. It doesn't look like the picture this time. It came in an unmarked jar, nothing indicating what the product actually was.
This is the first lotion I've tried that is so smooth. It isn't greasy or thick, which I love. I can already see a difference!

I love this product, it is holy grail. I use it every single night. I love how thick it is, the consistency makes my skin so cool and smooth. It's a little pricey but it's definitely worth it. I would recommend this to anyone

I really like this cream as I have dry skin and it keeps my skin hydrated all night. It's gentle to use every day. Only complaint is I have combo skin and my nose is super oily - so this makes it slicker and shiny.
Excellent night cream My skin feels soft no more dry patches no more red patches does not feel oily in the mornings after using this night cream and for the price it's a steal

i'm so happy i discovered FAB about a year and a half ago. i love all of their ultra repair products but this one is by far my favorite. a few months ago i ran out of it and switched to a cheaper moisturizer to save money. i am prone to breakouts and have cystic acne. i get a lot of dark spots and have combination to oily skin. i finally was so sick of the dark spots and the blemishes not clearing so i went back to FAB. literally after one use, i woke up with the dark spots significantly faded. my skin is so sensitive and i love the gentle smell. it feels like butter on my face but has never caused breakouts. my partner even said my face looked and felt so smooth and supple. i'm so thankful for FAB.
Wonderful product! Feels great on my face and 'soaks' in so nicely, not sticky or greasy feeling. Wake up with refreshed, smooth and hydrated skin!

This face cream is a life saver. Normally products make my skin break out (very acne prone skin) however this product not only made my skin softer but it made me look youthful. I will continue to use this product.
Just received so I can't say too much yet other than it makes my face feel super soft. It only takes a small amount to get a whole lot of moisture. So far so good!

avis.titre: The Perfect Moisturizer For Dry Skin
avis.texte: i have tried so many moisturizers for my dry peeling skin. i had yet to find one that i didnt have to keep reapplying over and over or one that would leave me with little white blisters or sebatious filaments. but this is my holy grail it absolutely does not clog my pores, can use a mi imal amount and youre good all night or day. i use this both day and night even though it is a "night cream". so perfect

I love this! Yes, the price is a little high but it's well worth it. An Ulta employee recommended this cream one day and I've used it ever since. On my 5th jar. I've had sensitive skin my whole life and acne prone skin to certain products but this cream has never once broken me out and has helped my heal through bad reactions to other products I've tried.

Anything this brand is truly a game changer. They have amazing products. Worth the purchase. Will leave your skin feeling amazing and with a nice glow. I would recommend to all people, especially if you have sensitive skin! First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Firming Collagen Cream

I use this along size the oat hemp oil and then Dr Jart Ceramidin cream. This has been a go to for a bit now, I use this every night of course and i feel it really helps me wake up with very hydrated skin.

avis.titre: Worth every penny to heal skin
avis.texte: I've tried nearly everything for sensitive skin over the years but this is the most soothing cream I've tried. I use it nightly and occasionally during the day when cosmetics or environment have irritated my skin. I especially use it in winter months and it leaves my face it instantly soothed, feels healing, and protected with a good amount of moisture.I've looked for a less expensive substitute but ALWAYS end up with is in my skincare regimen.

I could rave about this all day and all night. My skin is sensitive and this does not bother me at all. Fragrance free and non irritating for my skin. I highly recommend this product if your skin is sensitive or suffer from eczema.
